title: Two-point Gaussian profile bound
statement:
Let $a,b\in\mathbb R$ with $b\ge0$ and $a-b,a+b\in(0,1)$. If $U$ denotes the Gaussian isoperimetric profile, then
\[
U(a)\le\frac{\sqrt{U(a+b)^2+b^2}+\sqrt{U(a-b)^2+b^2}}{2}.
\]
replaced: Let $\Phi$ and $\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function and density, and put $Q=\Phi^{-1}$ and $I(p)=\varphi(Q(p))$ for $0<p<1$. If $b\ge0$ and $a-b,a+b\in(0,1)$, then $I(a)\le\bigl(\sqrt{I(a+b)^2+b^2}+\sqrt{I(a-b)^2+b^2}\bigr)/2$.
